description: To a peer recorded Ed3, its ED3-BASIC-RATE is the ceiling and the interleaver: our answer goes at the fastest of our waveforms not above its rate, with its interleaver.
note: As cas/make-called-accept, with a table and an Ed3 Caller. drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node makes no recommendation of its own (corpus-format.md 6.2); sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. At 2000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST has the Ed4 bit clear (octet 10: Ed3, which uses the 8-bit family, B-0232), so it records the peer Ed3 (B-0408). Its EOW is ED3-BASIC-RATE (0x146): data rate 0100, 1200 bps (Table C-5, C-0432, C-0433), interleaving 01, short (Table C-6, C-0435), Other Parameters 10, ignored (C-0441). That is the peer's ceiling and interleaver (C-0959, C-0960): by open question 10 (interp C-1288) the fastest of our waveforms whose data rate is not above 1200 bit/s, WN 4 (WN 5 is 1600; M0LTE.Ms110d docs/waveforms.md), with the Short interleaver, which is on the ladder (open question 5, interp C-1280). Our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED (octet 20, Ed4 and short-family bits clear, as the CAS answers an Ed3 request) goes at WN 4 Short. To a peer recorded Ed3 its header carries EMPTY (C-0419, C-0938) and there is no PADDING (C-1154). Fixture WN 4 Short: 25 bytes and 1200 ms a block (test data), so the 25-byte type 8 fills one block, 1950 ms, EOT and reception window ceil(1350 / 500) = 3. The link is made when it ends (B-0213, B-0400), with the soft link times derived from the answer wait (A-0321).
